# Data Access & Privacy

Great questions! Here's what you need to know:

**Getting your data:**
You can download or delete your data anytime under **"Account" > "Privacy"** in your Leafy account. Deletion takes up to 30 days and will cancel any subscriptions you have.

**Are your details sold:**
Our policy doesn't cover data selling practices—I can't answer that from what I have. I'd recommend checking our full **Privacy Policy** on the website, or I can escalate this to our team for a detailed answer. Would either help?
